item.description: - Sync Now in the Notifications menu (⌘R) asks your iPhone to send its History right away and fetches the day's verdicts - A new app icon without the badge, so the Dock no longer looks like something is unread - The unread column can be moved like the others, and its place is remembered - Column widths leave more room for the notification text

- Compact view is now a table: drag the headers to resize or reorder the columns, click one to sort, and Karui remembers it - Opening a notification puts its name in the title bar, with just Back, Mark as, and Delete above it - A Notifications menu with keyboard shortcuts: Mark as Read (⌘↩), Important, Neutral, Spam (⌘1–3), and Delete (⌘⌫) - The Help menu opens the Karui for Mac site and the bug report - View as is a button with a menu, and the toolbar's labels line up

- History from your iPhone, with Karui's verdicts, viewed as a list, apps, senders, or threads - Mark read, change category, or delete on the Mac and the iPhone follows; deletes can be undone - Compact view, search, filters, and a Full Disk Access card that explains the + button - Alerts for senders you've written to, via the iPhone's Karui for Mac settings
